_doc: Single source of truth for the drift-prone currency literals shared across the relay's compiled catalog (crates/dpay-relay/src/catalog.rs ic_rows — the SOLE catalog authority since the founder's 2026-08-28 registry removal) and the app's BUNDLED_NETWORKS icp-mainnet rows (app/config/catalog.ts; the flat BUNDLED_CATALOG view is DERIVED via icpCatalogOf since Catalog v2 2026-08-27 — there is exactly one bundled shape, the network-first one). Cross-checked by: (1) the Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in catalog.rs (catalog_truth_tests — pins EVERY IC row's ledger/minter principal, ids, order and locked shape), (2) a jest drift-alarm in app/__tests__/catalog.test.ts. A drift in either direction goes RED. Since the 2026-08-28 REAL-rows transplant the relay's ic_rows are the VERBATIM live-prod rows (fetched from prod /api/v1/currencies 2026-08-28) + the locked 7/8 rows, so this file is money-defining config, not just fallback alignment. The decimals.eth entry pins the 18-dec ckETH row (currency id 6 in BUNDLED_CATALOG, id 6 in ic_rows). The cketh_ledger principal (the native-ckETH ICRC ledger) is the SAME principal as cketh_gas_ledger (the ckETH ledger also serves as the gas source for ckERC20 cash-out). The testnet_* entries pin the real IC-testnet chain-key canisters (ckTESTBTC ledger/minter, Sepolia ckUSDC/ckETH ledgers + the Sepolia ckETH minter — currencies 3/4/5). The vchf_ledger/icp_ledger entries pin the two complete no-minter direct-ICRC assets (currency ids 7/8, added 2026-08-28 — see docs/specs/2026-08-28-vchf-icp-support-spec.md); icp_index is the OFFICIAL ICP index canister pinned by the relay's agent_ledger.rs ICP history adapter (a code pin, deliberately NOT a catalog field — no generic index_canister abstraction until a second ledger needs one). The veur_ledger/eurc_mint principals + decimals.veur/decimals.eurc entries pin the EUR dual-rail Stage 1 rows (currency 9 VEUR, a complete no-minter direct-ICRC mainnet IC asset, + the solana EURC asset with its mainnet mint, added 2026-09-06); eurc_mint lives under principals (not a dedicated mints object) because the spec locked it there alongside the other money-defining addresses. The wire_consts object is the canister half (cross-checked by a Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in crates/dpay-canister/src/types.rs + a jest drift-alarm added by the app side): RETRIEVE_BTC_MIN_AMOUNT mirrors types.rs and the relay's ckBTC withdraw floor; MINT_ACCOUNT (32 bytes of 0xFF) mirrors types.rs and the relay's MINT sentinel / the app's MINT_HEX.

swap_venue._doc: MEASURED 2026-09-08 off the LIVE pool's own `metadata` query (anonymous, read-only, https://icp-api.io). NOT a production input: production reads token0/token1/fee off the pool at request time (crates/dpay-relay/src/agent_ledger.rs swap_pool_metadata), because a remote system's pair order is a fact to read, never a constant to assume. This block exists for exactly two jobs: (1) it is the order the OFFLINE fake-IC stub pool is seeded in (crates/dpay-relay/src/ic_gateway.rs FakeIc::from_catalog), pinned by the Rust drift alarm in catalog.rs so the fake can never again agree with a stale pin instead of with the venue; (2) `just swap-venue-probe` asserts the LIVE pool still reports exactly these values. The 2026-09-07 build pinned the REVERSE order as a constant and seeded the fake from the same pin, so the closed loop proved only its own consistency while live production quoted each direction under the other direction's label — see docs/specs/2026-09-08-conversion-hardening-plan.md.
